security_intro: Honest about what a mandate protects – and what it doesn’t.
security_01_1_1: A manipulated agent can only do what the mandate allows.
security_01_1_2: Critical actions need an explicit rule or a person.
security_01_1_3: Every decision is logged; changes to the log are noticed.
security_01_1_4: Mandates are plain files you can read and check.
security_01_2_1: A hacked home guard or hub.
security_01_2_2: Mistakes in your own rules – an allow is an allow.
security_01_2_3: Devices that can be controlled without the guard.
security_01_2_4: What the agent’s provider does with your conversations.
security_02_text: Mandates and logs are stored and evaluated inside your home. Only confirmation questions go to your phone – nothing is sent to us. This website itself uses no cookies and no tracking.
security_03_text: Please report it privately on GitHub. We acknowledge every report within 72 hours.
